findings.message: <video id="s1-vid"> has data-start="0.40" inside a sub-composition. Nested media timing is local to its composition by default; a nonzero value can be confused with a legacy root-global timestamp.
findings.fixHint: Keep data-start="0.40" if it is composition-local. If this is a legacy root-global timestamp, add data-hf-media-start-basis="global"; otherwise convert it to local time by subtracting the host start.

findings.message: GSAP tweens overlap on "#s1-mac" for scale between 0.28s and 0.40s.
findings.fixHint: Shorten the earlier tween, move the later tween, or add `overwrite: "auto"`.

findings.message: <video id="s4-phi"> has data-start="3.1" inside a sub-composition. Nested media timing is local to its composition by default; a nonzero value can be confused with a legacy root-global timestamp.
findings.fixHint: Keep data-start="3.1" if it is composition-local. If this is a legacy root-global timestamp, add data-hf-media-start-basis="global"; otherwise convert it to local time by subtracting the host start.

findings.message: 4 tl.fromTo() calls target "#s4-ring" with no stable baseline. The last-authored fromTo "from" values become the element's resting state for any seek before the first tween actually runs, because GSAP applies fromTo from-values at authoring time (immediateRender), not at tween position.
findings.fixHint: Add `immediateRender: false` to every fromTo except the earliest-positioned one (at 0.66s), so pre-first-tween seeks keep its "from" values. A hiding `tl.set(..., 0)` baseline trips gsap_timeline_set_initial_hide, and a `gsap.set` authored before the fromTo calls is overwritten by them.

findings.message: Initial hidden state for "#s4-ph" is set via tl.set(...) at position 0 inside the paused timeline. A zero-duration set at 0 does not render while the playhead sits exactly at 0, so frame 0 shows the un-hidden state.
findings.fixHint: Use gsap.set(...) (immediate, outside the timeline) for initial states, or author the hidden state directly in CSS/attributes.
